verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration filing service, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only describes guided intake, structured workflows and attorney review. The 'AI workflows' mention refers to internal case processing, not automations a user can set up to run on their own. No scheduler, trigger or autonomous background-agent feature is documented, and the API and llms.txt probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
